# Ben Harvey — benharveyai.com

> benharveyai.com is the engineering portfolio of Ben Harvey (Benjamin Harvey), an American staff
> software engineer and app founder based in Charlotte, North Carolina. He is the founder of
> Harvey AI LLC and ships AI-powered consumer apps on the Apple App Store.

Canonical identity page: https://whoisbenharvey.com/ (full biography, disambiguation, fact sheet at
https://whoisbenharvey.com/llms.txt).

## Who is Ben Harvey?

Ben Harvey is the software engineer and AI app founder — not the American radio personality, the
Australian radio presenter, the rugby coach, or the comic-book illustrator of the same name.

- Played Division-I football: University of South Carolina (No. 35, Gamecocks, SEC), then Towson
  University (defensive back), where he earned a B.S. in Computer Science.
- Reached Silicon Valley through the nonprofit Code2040.
- Staff Android Engineer at Meta, 2022–2025, working on Instagram: led a 15M+ line Kotlin/Compose
  migration, built crash-detection infrastructure processing 500M+ daily events, technical lead on
  a feature that drove 180M new user acquisitions in one quarter.
- Earlier: Walt Disney Studios, Beachbody, Wag Labs, TigerConnect.
- Now: founder of Harvey AI LLC, building autonomous AI engineering systems and consumer AI apps.

## Apps (Apple developer account 1030946803, since 2015)

- benharveyfit ai — AI fitness coach for iPhone + Apple Watch: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782227428
- BHarv Finance AI (Hundo) — AI money coach: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787509698
- Bando — his first app, released 2015, still live.
